## Church leaders

Inventory one flagship ministry with the worksheet — the Sunday production, the building, the missions model. Count costs to members (volunteer burnout, formation displaced by performance), to the neighborhood (traffic, land use, a campus dark six days a week), and to the wider Body (the smaller congregations your growth draws from — counted fully in Module 7's remedies). Present the uncomfortable line items to leadership before any solutions are proposed.
